chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Faḍḍāl, from al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿUlwān al-Kalbī, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥazawwar al-Ghanawī, from Aṣbagh ibn Nubātah al-Ḥanẓalī, who said:

I saw Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام on the day he opened al-Baṣrah, and he rode the mule of Rasūl Allāh صلى الله عليه وآله. Then he said: “O people, shall I inform you of the best of creation on the Day when Allah gathers them?” Then Abū Ayyūb al-Anṣārī stood up before him and said: “Yes, O Amīr al-Muʾminīn, narrate to us, for you were present while we were absent.” He said: “The best of creation on the Day when Allah gathers them are seven from the descendants of ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib. None denies their merit except a kāfir, and none rejects it except one who is obstinate.”

Then ʿAmmār ibn Yāsir, may Allah have mercy on him, stood and said: “O Amīr al-Muʾminīn, name them for us so that we may know them.” He said: “The best of creation on the Day when Allah gathers them are the messengers, and the best of the messengers is Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله, and the best of every community after its prophet is the waṣī of its prophet, until a prophet reaches him. Indeed, the best of the awṣiyāʾ is the waṣī of Muḥammad عليه وآله السلام. Indeed, the best of creation after the awṣiyāʾ are the martyrs. Indeed, the best of the martyrs are Ḥamzah ibn ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib and Jaʿfar ibn Abī Ṭālib. He has two dyed wings with which he flies in al-jannah; no one from this ummah besides him has been granted two wings. This is a thing by which Allah honored Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله and ennobled him. And the two grandsons are al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn, and al-Mahdī عليهم السلام; Allah makes him whomever He wills from among us, Ahl al-Bayt.”

Then he recited this verse: “And whoever obeys Allah and the Messenger, then they are with those upon whom Allah has bestowed favor, from among the prophets, the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous; and excellent are those as companions. That is the bounty from Allah, and Allah suffices as All-Knowing.”

key_terms.أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ: the People of the Household of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله, from whom the Mahdī is designated
key_terms.الرُّسُلُ: the messengers of Allah, described here as the highest category of creation
key_terms.السِّبْطَانِ: the two grandsons, referring here to al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام
key_terms.الشُّهَدَاءُ: the martyrs, ranked after the awṣiyāʾ in excellence
key_terms.الْأَوْصِيَاءِ: the successors appointed after prophets, with the waṣī of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله singled out as the greatest among them
key_terms.الْمَهْدِيُّ: the Mahdī عليه السلام from Ahl al-Bayt, included among the specially honored figures
key_terms.خَيْرُ الْخَلْقِ: the best of creation in rank before Allah on the Day of Gathering

ai.seo_question: Who are described as the best of creation on the Day of Resurrection in this hadith of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a hierarchy of excellence on the Day of Gathering, beginning with the prophets, then the awṣiyāʾ, then the martyrs, while highlighting the unique virtues of select members of Banū ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib and Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام. It concludes by linking these ranks to Qur'an 4:69-70, showing that divine favor encompasses prophets, the truthful, martyrs, and the righteous.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Al Hsayn Bin Ulwan Al Kalby, from Ali Bin Al Hazawwar Al Ghanawy, from Asbagh Bin Nubata Al Hanzaly who said,

‘I saw Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> on the day he<sup>asws</sup> was victorious over Al-Basra and rode the mule of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, then said: ‘O you people! Shall I<sup>asws</sup> inform you with the nest of the creature on the Day Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Gather them?’ So Abu Ayoub Al-Alansary stood up to him<sup>asws</sup> and said, ‘Yes, O Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>! Narrate to us, for you<sup>asws</sup> were present and we were absent’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The best of the creatures on the Day Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Gather them, are seven from the sons of Abdul Muttalib. None will deny their merits except for an Infidel, nor would anyone reject it except for a renegade’.

So Ammar Bin Yasir, may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> have Mercy on him stood up and he said, ‘O Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>! Name them for us in order for us to recognise them’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The best of the creatures on the Day Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Gather them are the Rasools<sup>saww</sup>, and that the most superior of the Rasools<sup>as</sup> is Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>, and that the most superior of every community after its Prophet<sup>saww</sup> is the successor<sup>as</sup> of its Prophet<sup>as</sup>, until he<sup>as</sup> comes across a (another) Prophet<sup>as</sup>. 
Indeed! And the most superior of the succesors<sup>as</sup> is the successor<sup>asws</sup> of Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>, may the greetings be upon him<sup>saww</sup> and his<sup>saww</sup> Progeny<sup>asws</sup>. Indeed! And the most superior of the creatures after the succesors<sup>as</sup> are the martyrs. Indeed! And the most superior of the martyrs is Hamza<sup>asws</sup> Bin Abdul Muttalib<sup>asws</sup>, and Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> Bin Abu Talib<sup>asws</sup>. For him<sup>asws</sup> are two fresh wings. He<sup>as</sup><sup>ws</sup> flies with these two in the Paradise. No one from this community has been Granted two wings apart from him<sup>asws</sup>. It is a thing which Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Prestige Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> with, and Ennobled him<sup>saww</sup>, and the two grandsons Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> and Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>, and Al-Mahdy<sup>asws</sup>. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Make him<sup>asws</sup> to be the one whomsoever Allah<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires from us<sup>asws</sup>, the People<sup>asws</sup> of the Household’.

Then heasws recited this Verse [4:69] And whoever obeys Allah and the Rasool, these are with those upon whom Allah has Bestowed Favours from among the Prophets and the Truthful and the Martyrs and the Righteous, and a goodly company are they! [4:70] That is the Grace from Allah, and Sufficient is Allah as the Knower’.
en.sarwar: 34. Muhammad ibn al-Husayn has narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from ibn al-Faddal from Ali ibn al-Nu‘man from abu Maryam al-Ansari who has said the following.

“I asked abu Ja‘far (a.s.),”How was the prayer for the dead body of the Holy Prophet (s.a)?” The Imam (a.s.) said, “When Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) washed his body and he placed him in the shroud and covered his body then ten persons came in and they walked around him. Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) then stood in the middle of them and said, “God showers His blessings upon the Prophet and the angels seek forgiveness for him. Believers, pray for the Prophet and greet him with, “Peace be with you.”
The group also said what the Imam (a.s.) had said until the people of Madina and people of ‘Awali also said so.”
